label: PAPER config. Null means unset. This file is not market data and not a fill.
bankNote: A prior desk balance of 200 USD is not an authorized default. Leave bankUsd null until you enter the paper bank.
realizedProfitNote: Leave null. Running profit is derived from the journal. Set initialRealizedProfitUsd only for an unknown starting balance, with initialRealizedProfitSource user-entered.
liquidityNote: Leave null. Liquidity must come from a verified candidate, not this file.
